economy.summary: Cerrato's campaign website lists fighting the rising cost of living among her priorities for working families in the 151st District.
economy.short: Lists fighting the rising cost of living as a priority.

taxes.summary: Cerrato's campaign website states she supports keeping property taxes low and holding government accountable.

abortion.summary: Cerrato's campaign website states she supports making reproductive freedom state law to protect access to abortion.
abortion.short: Supports making reproductive freedom state law protecting abortion access.

education.summary: Cerrato's campaign website states she supports fairly funding public schools and making childcare more accessible and affordable.
education.short: Supports fairly funding public schools; more accessible, affordable childcare.

healthcare.summary: Cerrato's campaign website describes her committee work on improving access to essential health services and supporting mental health initiatives.
healthcare.short: Describes work improving health-service access and mental health support.

energy.summary: As the incumbent, Cerrato co-sponsored House Bill 2277 in the 2023-2024 session, which amends the Alternative Energy Portfolio Standards Act; her campaign website does not detail a separate energy position.
energy.short: Co-sponsored bill amending Alternative Energy Portfolio Standards Act.

guns.summary: Cerrato's campaign website states she supports adopting sensible gun legislation to better protect communities and schoolchildren.
guns.short: Supports adopting sensible gun legislation to protect communities, schoolchildren.
